item.tib: 'jig rten snod bcud kyi rnam bzhag nyer mkho rab gsal
item.coloph: ces pa'ang lam rim kyi dmigs rnam skyongs pa rnams kyis snying rje'i dmigs yul gyi don spyi mtshon pa dang / mchod pa'i maN+Dal gyi bkod pa la nye bar mkho ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis chags tshad kyi mtshon byed dgos tshul gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngo mi ldog par srid pa'i mdzod phug gi gzhung rtsa bar bzung zhing rtsa rgyud dang dri med las kyang cung zad btus te khod spungs dbra zhig ston pas nye bar bris pa kun la phan pa'i dpyid du gyur cig/
